_about: E. M. Cope (Edward Meredith Cope, 1818-1873), Fellow of Trinity College, Cambridge. Classical scholarship (lane B). Raw IA OCR: An Introduction to Aristotle's Rhetoric, with analysis, notes and appendices (London and Cambridge: Macmillan, 1867; Toronto scan) and The Rhetoric of Aristotle with a Commentary, revised and edited by J. E. Sandys (Cambridge University Press, 1877, 3 vols.; Greek text with English commentary, vol. I Greek-heavy). His Gorgias (1864) and Phaedo (1875) translations are on the plato shelf. Not taken: the 1970 reprint scans of the Rhetoric. US public domain. No uids minted.
